senses.gloss: (with על) to have compassion on, pity; to befriend.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 33a">Ber. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>כל מי … אסור לרַחֵם עליו</he> you must not befriend him who has no sense (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 27:11">Is. XXVII, 11</cite>).

<cite ref="Shabbat 151b:14">Sabb. 151ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המְרַחֵם … מְרַחֲמִין עליו וכ׳</he> he who shows mercy to creatures (men), will be shown mercy in heaven (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 13:18">Deut. XIII, 18</cite>), v. <cite ref="T00528"><he>רַחֲמָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18a:7">Ab. Zar. 18ᵃ</cite> <he>מן השמים יְרַחֵמוּ</he> heaven will have mercy (protect me); <cite ref="Niddah 45a:44">Nidd. 45ᵃ</cite>.
Sot. VIII, 1 יְרַחֲמוּ עליכם they will have mercy on you (spare your lives); a. fr.—Trnsf. to give suck to a strange animal.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 24a:17">Bekh. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>אינה מְרַחֶמֶת אלא וכ׳</he> no dam gives suck to a stranger, unless she has had a child of her own.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 24a:10">Ib.</cite> <he>מרחמת אע״פ וכ׳</he> she may give suck, even if she has never given birth.

senses.gloss: to stimulate the maternal instinct (v. רֶחֶם) of an animal after confinement by inserting a lump of salt into the womb.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:1">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:2">XVI</cite>), 2 <he>מְרַחֲמִין היינו בהמה טהורה ביו״ט</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>על בהמה</he>) we (in my father’s house) used to stimulate &c. on a Holy Day; <cite ref="Shabbat 128b:16">Sabb. 128ᵇ</cite> <he>על בהמה</he>; Y. ib. XVIII, end, 16ᶜ <he>על הבהמה</he>.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9<sup>24</sup></cite> <he>אם נופלים אנו … מִתְרַחֵם עלינו אין אנו מִתְרַחֲמִים עליו</he> if we fall into David’s hands, he will have pity on us, but if David fall into our hands, we shall have no pity on him; Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ bot. <he>הוא מרחם … אנו מרחמין</he>).
